title: Check-in

history.off: History is turned off in settings; new check-ins are not logged.
history.showing: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}}. Export CSV for all.

intro: Who checked in at which seat, and whether the background found their switch port. A PIN check-in from a PC on its own port teaches Floorbit the seat's port.
verifierError: The port lookup failed last time: {{error}}. It tries again by itself.

count.notWiredSub: Phones and Wi-Fi: no port to find
count.reviewSub: Ports that clash with another seat or the patch plan

search: Seat, nick, IP, MAC or port
retryFor: Look for the port of {{seat}} again
emptyDesc: Check-ins show up here as people open the check-in page.
reviewEmptyDesc: No learned port clashes with another seat or the patch plan.

conflict.shared: Seats {{seat}} and {{other}} checked in on the same port
conflict.plan: Seat {{seat}} checked in on the port the patch plan gives to {{other}}
conflict.taken: Seat {{seat}} was taken over by another nick
conflict.area: Seat {{seat}} checked in on a port meant for seats {{other}}

conflictHelp.shared: Usually a small switch under the table or a wrong PIN. Walk over, then forget the wrong seat's port.
conflictHelp.plan: Either the patch plan or the check-in is wrong. Check the cable, then fix the plan or forget the port.
conflictHelp.taken: Someone checked in with this seat's card after another nick. Ask at the seat if that is right.
conflictHelp.area: A wrong PIN or a card on the wrong seat. Walk over, then forget the port if it is wrong, or fix the area.

portalIntro: Phones and laptops ask the local agent whether they still need to check in (DHCP option 114). The agent fetches the list of checked-in clients from here; each fetch is listed below. Nothing is ever blocked, and it stays off unless you add the DHCP option.
portalNoUrl: Public URL is not set (Settings › General), so the agents answer "no portal" to everyone.
portalEmptyDesc: With DHCP option 114 pointing at a local agent, its fetches show up here.

off.title: Check-in is off
off.desc: Turn on seat check-in in the settings to see who checked in at which seat. Past events' check-ins are below.
off.askAdmin: An admin can turn on seat check-in in the settings. Past events' check-ins are below.
